channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andre Roberson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andre Roberson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Andre Roberson's G League return:

“A lot of respect for it. I think it takes a lot of humility when you've got as accomplished of an NBA career as he does. I just think it's pure love of the game.”

Mark Daigneault on Andre Roberson, Feb 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Clemente Almanza:Mark Daigneault on Andre Roberson’s recent presence with the Thunder:

“He’s a fan favorite inside of our organization…He’s just a really good spirit and great guy… We’re happy he’s got a home here in OKC.”

Mark Daigneault on Andre Roberson, Jan 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.

item.title: Hamidou Diallo on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Hamidou Diallo on what he’s learned from Roberson:

“He’s a great defender. Having him around as a mentor and a brother is great for me and great for this team.”

Hamidou Diallo on Andre Roberson, Jul 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Joe Mussatto:Donovan on Roberson:

“He's in good shape, but I know he can be in better shape.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @joe_mussatto.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
BrandonRahbar: Billy Donovan on Roberson’s return:

“It was great. The guys couldn’t be more excited for him. I know I was. You were able to see glimpses of what makes him such a great defensive player. He actually played really really well.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jul 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Chris Paul on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Chris Paul on Roberson tonight:

“To see him out there playing the game he loves was special for everyone.”

Chris Paul on Andre Roberson, Jul 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Enes Kanter Freedom on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Enes Kanter on Andre Roberson's return after 2.5 years since his knee injury:

“That's my brother, man. It feels so good to see him out there.”

Enes Kanter Freedom on Andre Roberson, Jul 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson:

“For me, it’s been inspiring to see him out there. I couldn’t be happier for him. He knows who he is as a player. He knows he’s an elite defensive player. Andre understands the bigger picture.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jul 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson:

“I think we will have to see. But I’m encouraged by what’s he’s done the first two days.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jul 11, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Chris Paul on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Erik Horne:Chris Paul on Andre Roberson being back in practice:

“It’s the best thing ever. When I talk about a guy being consummate teammate, for a guy to go through all the things he’s been through, I’m so happy for him. He’s had some of the toughest times people wouldn’t even know.”

Chris Paul on Andre Roberson, Jul 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @ErikkHorne.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Donovan on voluntary workouts, said all Thunder players have come in to work out, including Andre Roberson:

“In my conversations with Andre, he feels really good and he feels like he’s made really significant progress.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jul 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @ErikkHorne.

item.title: Sam Presti on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Sam Presti on Andre Roberson’s return:

“The time has really helped Dre. We haven’t got to see him in real basketball yet. We’re in a better place than we were on March 11 for sure. But we won’t know until we get into team practice but we’re hopeful.”

Sam Presti on Andre Roberson, Jun 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Erik Horne:Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson not playing in the scrimmage:

“We've had three or four really good days. I think they felt like this was an opportunity to give him a little bit of rest. We're not going to push him into situations where we're going to set him back.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Oct 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Erik Horne:Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson's setback:

“I'm disappointed because of how hard he's worked to get to this point,but I still believe he'll have the impact he's had while he's been out with some of our younger players.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Nov 30, 2018. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Paul George on Billy Donovan, Andre Roberson, Steven Adams
item.description:
“But being around Sam, being around Russ, being around [coach] Billy [Donovan], Dre [Andre Roberson], Steven [Adams], I gained a brotherhood. [Giving that group only] one year just didn’t sit well with me. I went to war, I went to battle, we made the playoffs, we were in the hunt, and we stuck together all year long. You never heard of any turmoil, no matter how we played, in the locker room. We built a real brotherhood there and I didn’t want to walk away from that.”

Paul George on Billy Donovan, Andre Roberson, Steven Adams, Jul 26, 2018. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Hamidou Diallo on Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Andre Roberson, Jerami Grant
item.description:
“I have Russell Westbrook, Paul George, Andre Roberson, Jerami Grant, guys that have been playing in the league for so long. Hopefully, one of those guys will take me under their wing,and I’ll get to know what they did their rookie year that made them end up where they are now. A guy like Russell Westbrook, for him to take me under his wing and just be able to teach me the ropes and be able to teach me what he did his rookie year is a blessing.”

Hamidou Diallo on Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Andre Roberson, Jerami Grant, Jul 13, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Fred Katz:Donovan on Roberson:

“Dre's situation probably took a lot out of us, out of the team... We lost a little bit there,and rightfully so.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jan 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Fred Katz:Billy Donovan on if Andre Roberson has become the best perimeter defender in the NBA:

“He’s as good as anybody I’ve ever been around and ever seen. There’s a lot of great defenders in this league. I think he’s certainly right up there with the best of them, if not the best.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Jan 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Alex Abrines
item.description:
Erik Horne:Billy Donovan on Alex Abrines’ defense:

“He’s never going to be Andre Roberson,but he can be a good team defender.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Alex Abrines, Dec 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson
item.description:
Fred Katz:Donovan on leaving Roberson in during hacking:

“I thought it was important as a coach I show confidence in him.”

Billy Donovan on Andre Roberson, Apr 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.
